strata_notes: Size bins use source-pixel bounding-box area, not aircraft type.
Predicted-size count errors can include localization crossing a size-bin boundary.
Dataset weather is coarse metadata; actual AOI quality remains unknown.
AP50 is 101-point interpolated AP at IoU=0.5 with candidate score floor 0.005.
Crowding bins use annotated aircraft per tile: 0, 1, 2-5, and 6+.
Zero labels alone do not verify an empty apron.
Geography labels are supplied source metadata; unknown stays unknown.
Only the supplied fixed operating point is evaluated.

unmatched_overlap_diagnostic.note: Unmatched prediction/truth overlaps are localization candidates only. They do not prove aircraft identity and do not change TP/FP/FN.

sampling_limitations.statement: These are descriptive metrics from a source-correlated sample. Tiles may overlap within an airfield; counts are per tile and cannot be summed into an airport inventory. Small geographic and negative strata do not establish regional or operational reliability.

localization.notes: Conditional on matches at IoU .5; unmatched labels remain false negatives.

reviewed_negative_false_alarms.limitations: Reviewed windows from few related captures are not independent full-airfield surveys; area estimate uses local source spacing, not exact geodesic area.

limitations: Small targeted validation cohort; no independent generalization conclusion.
90 seconds bounds training updates between steps, excluding baseline/candidate validation and initialization.
Create training/STOP for cooperative cancellation between updates.
Stratified diagnostic cohorts are not prevalence samples.

Failed/unsuitable scenes have null counts; partial-coverage scenes are excluded from primary accuracy denominators because full-source labels can cover unavailable pixels. Each workflow reports its own successful complete-image denominator.
Full scenes, tile crops and negative windows may share captures; metrics are separate and never summed.
Independent NAIP imagery is aerial and manually annotated, not an independent satellite benchmark.
Accepted-only workflow AP50 is intentionally unavailable; candidate-level AP50 belongs to baseline report.
Supplementary containment is a geometry heuristic and is not selected from evaluation scores.
